root:0000.classification: Game C, mirror assembly, DOS I/O

anchors: Both startup entries seed Rnd with 1 and then enter ResetGame. DOS reaches platform setup through an RTLink vector.

Main calls it at the end of startup. Both call ResetData and conditionally PlayOpeningSequence before entering the game loop. DOS passes DS:007e, 'At beginning of ResetGame() loop.', to its diagnostics.
ResetGame calls the opening sequence before gameplay. Both use the independently paired recording-player on/off calls in this path.
Called by NextFrame and calls DrawMessage in both. Handles elapsed/minutes/seconds state. DOS passes the minute, second and time-expired messages.
Both call AddRoomTrobs, IsLevelStartWithNISScreen, LoadCustomRoomData and DrawOppMeter. Both precede the meter routines.
Signed meter byte +1, capped at 12, written back before recomputing the meter delta. FM Towns 06fd–071a includes the same subtraction that DOS calls at 0e89.

Embedded at FM Towns 0713–0717. The current meter byte minus its immediately preceding base byte is stored in the immediately following byte. DOS has a separate far-return helper with exactly that three-byte field layout.
Checks the health delta byte, copies 64-byte character records, calls DrawKidMeter and DrawOppMeter. Same base/current/delta relationship as BoostMeter.
Health update clamps against zero and the maximum. Both are called by NextFrame, CutCheck, RoofKillKidOnWharf and FinlWatchKid.

Clears the three-byte joystick state, calls PrincePoll, handles a pause state by drawing a message and waiting, then returns the poll code or signed joystick button byte at offset +2. FM pause/sound implementation differs.
Rectangle copy in DoCleanCut, with matching condition/field fingerprint, between ClearKeyboard and ToggleInvertState. FM uses a platform blitter.
Same global timer toggle, 0 or 1080, song IDs 154 when clearing and 153 when setting, plus a separate changed flag set to 1. DOS sound dispatcher is root:0dd7:01b0.
Both set the weightless timer to 228, which the paired CTRL.Gravity routine tests, and request song 105. FM Towns adds ResetSnd and sets CueSnd to -1.
ResetGame calls this endpoint, which runs InitPort, clears peels and initializes current level to -1 in both.

Both mirror byte pixels row by row, using forward source and backward destination traversal across each row. Neighboring DOS entries 1377 and 140b independently match the adjacent RLE and packed-4-bit variants. FM ASM segment ownership is explicit.
RLE horizontal mirror reverses run/literal write direction. Both neighbor the byte and packed-nibble mirror entries and are called by DrawBFItem and DrawMidItem.
Reverses packed pixel rows and swaps high/low nibbles. Shared DrawBFItem and DrawMidItem callers.

root:0000.interpretation: PRINCE entries 0000–133f. BoostMeter and its inlined delta are direct anchors. MCGA1 is the distinct mirror run at 1344,1377,140b. The later DOS tail includes gameport I/O at 15d9.

root:0169.interpretation: ADD. The early three table appenders share AddImgInfoToBFItem, and DOS passes 'BackTable overflow in AddBImgToBTable(). Quit?' at DS:012e. GetSetImgSize/GetSetShapeItem share the same three shape lookup edges.

anchors: With clear state guards, both accept room/level combinations 27/6, 22/10, 1/14 and 9/8. FM Towns adds a special 9/8 alternate state path.

root:0284.interpretation: CHECKNIS. One-argument EraseScreenAfterNIS is also independently named by Mac, and the level-start guard uses the same four room/level pairs. FM drops the EraseScreenAfterNIS exception for 100.

anchors: Both normalize room coordinates with ±10 column adjustments and neighbor-table reads, and are called by ReadCell.
Calls Handler and GetUndefineCellId on room fallback. Shared ClipChar and MobLoose callers.

FM 01d6–028a dispatches state 2 through 6. Cases share the state/level tests 4 or 13 on 13, 27 on 6, y=-1 guarded by a state byte, and kind 3 with x negative or 9 and y=2. Returns zero or 20. FM case 4 adds a kind 16/level 9 arm.
Same short index wrapper around IndexCell. Shared callers IndexChar, ATMLoose, ATMDart and ATMSlideRock.
If the preceding direction byte is nonzero, negate the incoming word, add it to the adjacent FChar X word, return the sum. DOS 0360 instead returns the sum without storing it.
Animation opcode loop and indexed CS dispatch use GetSeqOp. Shared callers StartFall, FallOn and CtrlPlayer.
Both fetch sequence byte and advance the sequence index. Associated with the AnimChar opcode dispatcher in both.
Only character kind 0 or 1 permits storing the incoming byte. Both use the same guard and sole stored argument.
Action 4 or 9 only. If the timer is set add 1 and cap at 4, otherwise add 3 and cap at 33. FM _WeightlessTimer independently links this to PRINCE.GoWeightless.
Clears exactly two adjacent velocity bytes. The second is the byte incremented and capped by the independently paired Gravity in both builds. Located between AddCharVel and DecLifePts in both.
Both call Gravity, AddCharVel, DecLifePts and SetKidDeathMethod in the undefined-room fall path.
Both call GrabTest and ResetCharY, and are called by Falling and AltarShadowProg.
Shared compact predicate fingerprint, reads above/ahead-cell results and has common caller FallOn.
Coordinate-difference routine, identical 21 decoded instructions by count and normalized constant/field fingerprint. Called by GetDist and DoRunJump.
Subtract 3 from input, signed divide by 63, decrement quotient if the shifted input is <=0.
Calls LoadSelect, ClrJoystick, CheckForEndOfRecording and SaveSelect in both builds.
Called by PlayerCtrl and calls paired FaceJoystick and InvertJoystick plus CheckRecordedDirForChar.
Zeros the four Dir bytes in order 3,2,0,1 and returns byte 1. The neighboring FaceJoystick and InvertJoystick identify the same pairs independently.
Five-byte copy from Dir to SelDir. PlayerCtrl calls it before input handling and the next routine copies the same fields in reverse.
Five-byte copy from SelDir back to Dir, called by PlayerCtrl, and the inverse of the immediately preceding SaveSelect.
Zeroes five contiguous bytes. In both builds the immediately preceding two entries copy the same five bytes to and from the current selection, distinguishing this buffer reset from ClrAll.
One signed word argument, conditionally negated if facing byte is zero. Same facing byte neighbors current Char X in both builds. Unlike AddFCharX, no sum or store.
Both call MakeFCharClipRect, IsCharNonViewable and ComputeOffsetCellRect in the clipping routine. Shared SetupKid caller.
Computes a character cell index and calls IndexCell1, with SetupKid and SetupOpponent as common callers.
Six-way potion dispatch: second through fourth cases call BoostMeter, GoWeightless and ToggleInvertState in both. Both use sound constants 101 and 14, and clear the same selector after dispatch.

Copies ten words from FChar into the save record. Immediately following DOS 1c50 and FM 1fc7 copy back with source/destination reversed. The direction from active to saved is observable in neighboring FChar reads.
Copies exactly ten words from save record to active FChar. Reverses SaveFChar and is called after temporary FChar processing by SetupCarpet and SetupFlame in both.
FM inlines the 64-byte Kid to Char copy at 13e3–13ed. DOS has a separate far-return routine performing this exact record copy. FM LoadKidwOpp repeats the same copy as one step of a bigger routine.

root:02cc.interpretation: CTRL. Handler/ReadCell/undefined-room cluster, animation opcode dispatch, FChar and joystick state. Accepted helpers prove the name across the whole run. DOS has local helpers absent from the FM public list.

root:04a6.interpretation: CUSTOM. AddCustomPiecePeel calls and early piece/peel functions align, followed by room shape load/unload and room-specific restoration.

anchors: Load path uses PRINCE.SAV (DOS DS:03f4) or A:PRINCE.SAV (FM DS:120d), checks reads and restores state.
Create/update path uses two references to PRINCE.SAV or A:PRINCE.SAV, adjacent to the separate load routine.

root:052d.interpretation: DIALOG and DIALOG2 have overlapping rather than identical source membership. DIALOG draw/init then save/restore methods, DIALOG2 PRINCE.SAV/OPT paths, DOS-specific copy-protection and hall-of-fame helpers identified in Mac CODE 2.

root:078a.interpretation: DRAW. Long ordered run from redraw and drawing through sorting, meters and palette. Mac CODE 3 supplies the DOS tile-predicate names IsImpassable, IsMobFloor and IsWall, between graphics routines. FM lacks their publics.

root:107d.interpretation: Passes Pos=%d, '%s. Ticks = %ld', Waiting, and near/far heap corruption strings. ResetGame reaches memory diagnostics. No supported FM module identity.

root:1101.classification: Mixed engine C, x86 graphics assembly, DOS platform code

anchors: Both receive two coordinates and far pointers to destination rectangle and shape dimensions. Store top/left, add width and height from the shape words at +0/+2 to compute bottom/right, and return the destination pointer. DOS passes all four values on stack, FM carries the coordinates in registers.
Round request to 16-unit banks, scan occupancy from low bit while skipping set bits, return zero on exhaustion, commit successful mask with OR. ResetBanks and Get1stBank use the same 16-bit bitmap.
Clears occupancy word and ORs successive low bits while decrementing input. Same bitmap as AllocBanks.
Nested rows and columns remap nonzero indexed pixels using mask 0xf and 16-entry banks. Shared XlatShape caller.
Single mask argument, checks each bit up to a width of 16, and returns the first index. Shared XlatShape caller.
Palette mapping walks groups of 16 up to 256, with RGB address step 3. Both called by hGetNMapShpList.
Font/glyph layout uses repeated +10 and +6 fields and calls the independently paired MASKTOMCGA.
Shared 0x7f/0x70 header tests, uncommon -1436 case constant, +4 output field and paired CalcRowBytes, Get1stBank, TGATOMCGA and MASKTOMCGA calls.
Single rectangle input, compares +2/+6 and +0/+4, and returns true for degenerate/reversed spans. Shared MarkBufsForRect, LoadCustomRoomShapes and CheckGateInFore callers.
Looks up a font ID with the same FONT words 0x4e54/0x464f. Shared callers SetFont, DialogDrawNumber and GetDialog.
GRAF context font handle at +0x2a, one handle input, and a call from the SetFont chain in both. DOS returns the previous field; FM writes and returns the new handle.
Writes four coordinates, adding alternating deltas to the near edges and subtracting them from the far edges. Shared DrawCreditCategory and AddDRect callers.
Adds the two inputs to current port cursor words +0x24 and +0x22 in the same order. Neighbor MoveTo stores the same two fields directly and DrawString reads them.
Sets the same two words +0x22/+0x24 that Move increments. Shared DialogDrawStr and DrawCreditsPage callers.
Adds alternating offsets to all four edges, returns destination. Shared LoadCustomRoomShapes, DialogDrawStr and ComputeMobRect callers.
Rectangle intersection selects max near edges and min far edges, zeros four words on empty output, and returns Boolean. Shared AddImgInfoToBFItem and RedrawCellFast callers.
One font ID flows into a lookup for resource type FONT then to the independently paired hSetFont. FM returns the loaded font handle; DOS forwards the return of hSetFont.
Rectangle union selects min near and max far edges, writes four words. Shared RedrawCellFast, AddDRect and MarkTop callers.
Reads an ID and split long type such as FONT or SHAP. Shared hGetFont, CheckKidSetImg, GetCustomPieceShape and GetHorseShpInfo callers. Different native resource-map implementation.
Horizontal RLE run/literal loops, returns consumed source bytes by subtraction, RETF 10 in both.
Vertical RLE variant adds output stride and tracks columns. Both use RETF 14 and compute source bytes consumed.
One-bit mask conversion with low-three-bit width rounding, repeated bit shifts and byte emission, RETF 8. Shared XlatShape and XlatFont callers.
Packed nibble conversion with four-bit shifts, mask 0xf and odd-width handling. Shared XlatShape caller and RETF 10.
Horizontal LZ decoder uses 1024-byte (512-word initialization) ring, 0x3ff index mask, length bias 3 and RETF 10.
Uses the same LZ window, mask and length bias with vertical stride/column handling and RETF 14.
Typed SND lookup with high word 0x0053 and low 0x4e44. Both call hGetRsrc and propagate a handle or zero. DOS validates the handle.
Text-glyph conversion shares +2/+5, mask 7, bit 128, flag OR 1 and 4/8-way dimensions. RETF 8 in both.

root:1101.interpretation: Composite correspondence. XLATGRAF near the beginning, mixed PTOOL/GRAF/CLIPRECT/RESC around 4d6e–6f6a, UNPACK/TGATOMCG around 763e–78a5, SOUND2 hGetSnd at 807a and XLATTXT4 at 8670. Remaining provider families are unresolved. One DOS census frame covers these distinct FM units.

root:1d3a.interpretation: PAINTRLE is the closest FM body. The DOS entry is one clipped RLE raster loop and size/ABI differ from the FM assembly entry.

anchors: Resource handle and index, adds index−1 to base shape ID, loads SHAP type 0x5348:0x4150 and calls shape translation. Neighbor has an extra parameter.
SHAP lookup and translation chain with three arguments and extra option field. Shared SHAPE painting callers.

root:1d58.interpretation: HNEWSHPI. Two ordered SHAP ID lookups and translation paths with two and three arguments. HNEWSHPM is a separate FM module whose DOS frame has not been identified.

root:1d76.interpretation: Calls current-port font and graphics operations, plus a far-block flag wrapper. Multiple callers from DOS 052d dialog routines at 09b8 and 19aa. FM module still unresolved.

root:1de8.interpretation: INTRFACE. WaitKey calls CheckWaitFunc, while OpenRsrcVerify and CloseRsrcFile share GetRsrcMapHnd. DOS includes extra resource error handlers.

anchors: The FadeTo lifecycle calls InitFadeTo, the step function and this one-pointer cleanup in both builds. NIS animation also calls the same cleanup endpoint. FM releases a heap handle via p2h/Unlock/Free; DOS delegates to the far-block flag operation.

root:1e23.interpretation: FADE. Same InitFadeIn/ReadDACBlocks/SetDACBlocks and FadeTo initialization, step and cleanup. Shared accepted wrapper is named by its caller rather than the far-block bit mask.

anchors: Allocates and initializes a 44-byte port descriptor. Common InitDialog, CheckBPort and TransThroneRoom callers. DOS has a backport-allocation error string.
Frees the port buffer then near pointer. Common InitDialog and TransThroneRoom callers as in the allocation path.
Both compare exactly eight bytes (four coordinate words) for equality and normalize to 0/1. Both sit in a run with an AllocBackPort/DeallocBackPort pair.

root:1ead.interpretation: LGRAF. AllocBackPort has 44-byte allocation, paired with DeallocBackPort. EqualRect compares four coordinate words.

root:1ec9.interpretation: Frame's sole directly called routine uses root:0000:15d9 and 165e, then checks measured axes against 1 and 450. FM EVENT contains device support, but no anchored same helper.

root:1ecf.interpretation: SHAPE. FreeShpInfo/load/overlay/purge operations precede PrincePaintShapeIdx and neighboring lookups. PaintRLEShapeItem/PaintShapeItem share hNewShpItem1.

root:1f61.interpretation: UTIL. Matched AlterRect and Rnd, with hGetTxt4's typed lookup and SetRndSeed linkage. DOS frame has five far entries, FM lists seven publics.

root:1f74.interpretation: Called from ADD table overflow paths and a DRAW rectangle diagnostic. A GOLD-tag resource, temporary port switch and near-record field +0x20 occur here. No FM module identity established.

root:1fe6.interpretation: Census range contains all 21 pinned MSC runtime members, 1,166 bytes. FM has its own Borland runtime. No game-module correspondence.

root:21fe.interpretation: Reads high FLAGS bits and checks the 32-count shift behavior at the unique called entry 000c. FM counterpart unverified.

root:2203.interpretation: MZ entry at 0678, error strings, overlay dispatch routine at root image 22588 and 18-byte descriptors. The FM MZ port does not provide a comparable source module.

root:22e5.interpretation: At the end of the RTLink vector table and manager extension with code/data mixed. Treat as DOS linker/platform payload. No supported FM module.

original_facts.authority: DOS locked PRINCE.EXE, FM Towns MZ/TD source on CD, Mac application resource fork

overlay_17.evidence: Original relocated DS selector 30f3 appears in MOV AX,30f3; MOV DS,AX at root+1560. Input DOS strings at that segment agree with typed consumers.
